original: WPRPLACE (Italian: Parco Nazionale del Vesuvio) is an Italian national park centered on the active volcano Vesuvius, southeast from Naples. The park was founded on June 5, 1995, and covers an area of around 135 square kilometers all located within the Province of Naples.

Juni 1995 gegründet und umfasst eine Fläche von rund 135 Quadratkilometern, die sich alle in der Provinz Neapel befinden.
